trial_title: Lonafarnib With and Without Ritonavir in HDV (LOWR-1)
brief_summary: To Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Lonafarnib with and without Ritonavir Boosting in Adults With Genotype 1 Chronic Hepatitis D Virus (HDV) Infection (LOWR-1).

eligibility_table.criterion: Males or females, 18 to 65 years of age who are diagnosed with HDV by PCR
Males or females, 18 to 65 years of age who are diagnosed with HDV by PCR
Chronic hepatitis D infection, genotype 1, documented by a positive anti-HDV Ab test at least of 6 months duration and detectable HDV RNA by PCR within 3 months to study entry
eligibility_table.justification: The patient does not have chronic hepatitis D infection, as there is no mention of positive anti-HDV Ab test or detectable HDV RNA.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is there a documented positive anti-HDV Ab test for the patient that has been present for at least 6 months?

eligibility_table.criterion: Liver biopsy within the last two years
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about a liver biopsy within the last two years.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone a liver biopsy within the last 24 months?

eligibility_table.criterion: Positive viral load by quantitative PCR
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not been tested for viral load by quantitative PCR, as this information is not provided.
